append.detail: The composer offers Post, Poll and Ask to every member, Capture adds a Practice or Journey share, and a leader's Dispatch picks its reach (Circle, Hub, Nexus, Everyone) from the tiers they lead; createPost re-checks the pick. Polls are their own tables with a vote tally trigger (migration 20270346002400).
